response_text: The user picks a data structure to pass in. The user passes in a pointer to the data structure. The OS stores the pointer to this data structure on the stack- where R0 should be stored. When the thread’s state is read in, R0 is now the pointer to that data structure. The data structure is passed into the thread function and may be dereferenced to access the original data. It works because a pointer only needs one register to be passed along, so one could pass in any amount of data by passing in the reference to that data.\n
